summary: Dispatch for incoming collision setup messages. Interprets payload a1 according to message type a2 (18/19/20). Type 18 is acknowledged without any copy. Type 19 copies the payload into the global collision struct byte_7CA594 via CollisionStructCopy_efc0. Type 20 copies the payload into one of two device data buffers (unk_7CB318 or unk_7CB714) via CollisionDataCopy, selecting the destination by the device-create counter dword_7CB310 and incrementing it after the copy. Returns 1 for accepted types and 0 for any other type.

local_names.v3: selected device data destination for type-20 copy
local_names.v4: local 145-dword copy of the payload buffer

operations.description: Message type dispatch: a2 == 18 returns success immediately without copying any payload data.
Message type dispatch: a2 == 19 selects the global struct copy path; a2 == 20 selects the device data copy path; any other value returns 0 (rejected message).
qmemcpy copies the full incoming payload (145 dwords) from a1 into the local stack buffer v4 before either copy path.
CollisionStructCopy_efc0 writes type ID 19 and the first 61 dwords of v4 into the global collision struct byte_7CA594.
Destination selection for type 20: dword_7CB310 == 0 selects unk_7CB318, dword_7CB310 == 1 selects unk_7CB714, and any other value returns 1 without copying.
CollisionDataCopy writes type ID 20 and the first 61 dwords of v4 into the selected destination buffer (unk_7CB318 or unk_7CB714).
Increment the device-create counter dword_7CB310 after a type-20 copy so the next type-20 message selects the alternate buffer.
Return 1 for accepted types (18/19/20) and 0 for all other types.
